classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: De novo design of an 85 aa soluble protein: RFdiffusion generates an unconditional backbone, ProteinMPNN designs candidate sequences, Protenix refolds the top candidate, structure analysis and protein QC assess quality, and rank_designs returns the top-ranked sequence with rationale.
assumptions: Target length is fixed at 85 residues; RFdiffusion runs unconditional mode with length_min=length_max=85.
ProteinMPNN samples 8 sequences at temperature 0.1 from the generated backbone; only the top-1 by score is refolded.
Protenix-v2 is run without MSA (n_cycle=1, n_sample=1, n_step=20) for speed; pLDDT reflects in-silico folding confidence only, not experimental validation.
Solubility is assessed computationally via GRAVY score (negative favoured) and instability index (<40 preferred) from protein_qc; no wet-lab solubility data is available.
All inference runs locally on the 8× B200 cluster; no cloud scientific GPU inference is used.
Final response will carry the top-ranked 85 aa sequence plus rationale fields derived from structure_analysis and protein_qc outputs.
Provider selected a workflow template by reference; expanded it to the validated local workflow descriptor.

workflow_plan.name: rfdiffusion_backbone_design_round
workflow_plan.description: Generate one RFdiffusion backbone, design sequences, refold, analyze structure, QC, and rank candidates.

success_criteria.top_sequence: Single-letter 85 aa amino acid sequence of the top-ranked design
success_criteria.mean_plddt: Mean pLDDT > 70 on the Protenix-refolded structure
success_criteria.gravy: GRAVY score reported; negative value indicates hydrophilic/soluble character
success_criteria.instability_index: Instability index reported; <40 indicates predicted stability
success_criteria.rationale: Plain-language explanation of why this sequence ranks first, covering structural confidence, solubility indicators, and any notable residue-level liabilities
